parts.t: Terra Nova is Richmond's premier residential address — an upscale neighbourhood of luxury estate homes adjacent to the stunning Terra Nova Rural Park and the shores of the Fraser River. With top schools, executive homes, and a serene natural setting, it represents the pinnacle of Richmond living.
